high_level_description: The image depicts a TED Talk presentation on a stage. The setting is a dark auditorium with a large screen behind the speaker. The screen displays a split image: on the left, there is a smaller inset showing the same person as on the right, who appears to be the speaker. On the right side of the screen, there is a slide with the text "Your grandchildren will be the last generation to read and write." Below the screen, the iconic red TED logo is prominently displayed. The speaker is standing on a circular pink carpet, which is typical for TED Talks, symbolizing the stage area.
